import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Load the invasion_success dataset
invasion_success = pd.read_csv('/data/invasion_success_pathways.csv')

# Display the first few rows of the dataset
invasion_success.head()

# Check for missing values
invasion_success.isnull().sum()

# Check the distribution of mrt
sns.histplot(invasion_success['mrt'], kde=True)
plt.title('Distribution of Minimum Residence Time (mrt)')
plt.xlabel('Minimum Residence Time (years)')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.show()

# Check the relationship between introduction pathway and mrt
sns.boxplot(x='intro.pathway', y='mrt', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Minimum Residence Time by Introduction Pathway')
plt.xlabel('Introduction Pathway')
plt.ylabel('Minimum Residence Time (years)')
plt.show()

# Perform ANOVA to test for significant differences in mrt across pathways
model = sm.OLS(invasion_success['mrt'], sm.add_constant(invasion_success['intro.pathway'].astype('category').cat.codes))
results = model.fit()
anova_table = sm.stats.anova_lm(results, typ=2)
anova_table

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import f_oneway

# Load the invasion_success dataset
invasion_success = pd.read_csv('/data/invasion_success_pathways.csv')

# Display the first few rows of the dataset
invasion_success.head()

# Check for missing values
invasion_success.isnull().sum()

# Check the distribution of mrt
sns.histplot(invasion_success['mrt'], kde=True)
plt.title('Distribution of Minimum Residence Time (mrt)')
plt.xlabel('Minimum Residence Time (years)')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.show()

# Check the relationship between introduction pathway and mrt
sns.boxplot(x='intro.pathway', y='mrt', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Minimum Residence Time by Introduction Pathway')
plt.xlabel('Introduction Pathway')
plt.ylabel('Minimum Residence Time (years)')
plt.show()

# Group the data by introduction pathway and extract mrt values
groups = [invasion_success[invasion_success['intro.pathway'] == pathway]['mrt'] for pathway in invasion_success['intro.pathway'].unique()]

# Perform ANOVA to test for significant differences in mrt across pathways
f_statistic, p_value = f_oneway(*groups)
f_statistic, p_value

import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

# Load the invasion_success dataset
invasion_success = pd.read_csv('/data/invasion_success_pathways.csv')

# Fit a linear regression model to examine the interaction between intro.pathway and mrt on number.of.invaded.plots
model = smf.ols('number.of.invaded.plots ~ C(intro.pathway) * mrt', data=invasion_success).fit()
anova_table = sm.stats.anova_lm(model, typ=2)
anova_table
